description: This Dart source file defines the MatchRepository class responsible for translating user filter preferences into query parameters and delegating match fetching to the MatchService. It centralizes filter mapping logic and provides an interface for retrieving matches based on filters.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository responsible for converting FilterPreferences into query parameters and delegating the fetch to MatchService.

methods.name: fetchMatches
methods.description: Fetches a list of matches based on provided filters by mapping filters to query parameters and calling the match service.

methods.name: _mapFilters
methods.description: Converts FilterPreferences object into a map of query parameter names and values, handling nulls and enum to string conversion.
